title: Coctel de Camarones (Mexican Shrimp Cocktail) – A Refreshing No-Cook Appetizer
ldKeywords: 5 de mayo recipe, Mexican shrimp cocktail recipe, shrimp cocktail
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 to 2 tablespoons creamy horseradish ((add more or less according to spicy tolerance))
1 pound medium to large shrimp (shelled, deveined, and cooked)
Saltine crackers or tortilla chips (for serving)
ldInstructionsRaw: Stir together the ketchup, vegetable juice, horseradish, lime juice, hot sauce, and garlic powder until well combined. Taste and add more chile or hot sauce if you would like it spicier.
Add the onion, jalapeno (if using), cilantro, and shrimp and mix well. Gently stir in the avocado.
Serve in 4-ounce glasses with saltine crackers or corn tortilla chips.
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ 1 to 2 tablespoons creamy horseradish, (add more or less according to spicy tolerance)
▢ 1/2 teaspoon bottled hot sauce, recommend Tabasco
▢ 1 pound medium to large shrimp, shelled, deveined, and cooked
▢ Saltine crackers or tortilla chips, for serving
